label: D2 after a rewarded repeat of a2, mid-episode (trials ~10-65)
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass), and nearly only when the choice just made was a2 (99.9% of mass; in_action input = a2) and the previous trial was rewarded (98% of mass). Switch trials barely fire (0.1% of mass), so it marks a rewarded a2 that was repeated. It also depends strongly on episode time: about 9% rate on trials 10-59, falling to 0 after trial ~75 and near 0 on trials 0-2. That suggests a slow drift in the hidden state, not an input. The policy logit at D2 is strongly toward a2 (choice in [-8.9, -4.4]) on 99% of its activations. Magnitude is larger when the a2 choice led to a rare S1 transition (about 0.4-0.6 of max vs about 0.1-0.3 for common S2). The few top activations look like the step just after a single a1 deviation inside an a2 run. Does not fire at D1 or GO, after a1 choices, or after unrewarded trials. Dev F1 is 0.61 without the ep_trial window and 0.78 with it. Recorded the version with the window; all its variables are observed at D2.
